messages.message: Simulation
Simulation (for experts)
Interval
Minutes; How many match minutes will be simulated at each execution. 150 means that the whole match will be simulated at once.
Max. No. of Matches per Run
Maximum number of matches per simulation run. Reduce this number if you run the software on a slow server to avoid double simulations.
No formation set by user
What happens if a user has not set a formation.
No formation set by both teams
What happens if both teams do not have a valid formation.
Generate formation by system
Set result as 0:0
Set result as 3:0 for the opponent team
The system should generate a formation for all teams without an assigned user.
Offensive playing for computer formations
Offensive tactic setting in percent for formations generated by the system.
Allow ticket sales for friendly matches. Clubs will earn income from friendly matches.
Simulation Strategy
Class name of your own match simulation implementation.
Goalkeeper's Influence
percent; Goalkeeper's influence in preventing goals on shots.
Goal Shot Frequency
percent; 100% means standard frequency.
Frequency of a card after foul
percent; 100% means standard frequency.
Frequency of injuries
percent; 100% means standard frequency.
Weighting Strength
percent; Share of attribute Strength in total player strength.
Weighting Technique
percent; Share of attribute Technique in total player strength.
Weighting Stamina
percent; Share of attribute Stamina in total player strength.
Weighting Freshness
percent; Share of attribute Freshness in total player strength.
Weighting Satisfaction
percent; Share of attribute Satisfaction in total player strength.
Shooting power: Defenders
in percent of total player strength.
Shooting power: Midfielders
in percent of total player strength.
Shooting power: Strikers
in percent of total player strength.
Minimum match minutes for strength computation
in minutes; Minimum number of minutes for a player to be considered as "has played". Related to satisfaction and stamina adjustments.
Player block after number of yellow cards
After how many yellow cards a player gets blocked. 0 to never block.
Allow tactic changes by user during live simulation.
Permitted live changes of tactic
How often a user is allowed to change the offensive tactic and other options during a live match. 0 stands for not at all.
Players become tired (deduction of freshness) when they play. The deduction depends on minutes, age, stamina and offensivity.
Change of stamina
Number of points a player can gain or lose if they play or do not play.
Change of satisfaction
Number of points a player can gain or lose if they play or do not play.
Freshness gain when not playing
Number of points a player gains when they do not play.
Strength deduction on secondary position
percent; Weakening of players who play in their secondary position.
Strength deduction on foreign position
percent; Weakening of players who play in neither their main nor secondary position.
Home Field Advantage
Number of strength points which players of the home team will gain when the tickets are sold out. 0 for no advantage.
Max. injured matches
Maximum number of matches for which a player is blocked due to an injury. Note that the probability of being blocked for more than 7 matches is only 1%.
Max. blocked matches
Maximum number of matches for which a player is blocked due to a red card.
Players can also get injured during friendly matches and will be blocked for subsequent matches.
Simulation Observers
Comma-separated list of PHP classes that implement the interface ISimulationObserver and should be active during match simulation.
Simulator Observers
Comma-separated list of PHP classes that implement the interface ISimulatorObserver and should be active during match simulation.
Generate a new formation when the user has submitted a setup with less than 11 players (e.g. because a player got injured in the meantime).
Players lose freshness and gain stamina at friendly matches as well.
Player strength on computer formation
percent; Less than 100% means weaker players set by the system.
Players' skills (morale, stamina, fitness) change through national team matches as well.
